newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi prince to build $500mln skyscraper in Riyadh.
newsitem.headline: Saudi prince to build $500mln skyscraper in Riyadh.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's billionaire Prince Al-Waleed bin Talal plans to build a skyscraper that will house a Four Seasons Hotel in the Saudi capital Riyadh at an estimated cost of $500 million, Saudi newspapers said on Monday.

They said other Saudi investors were also involved in the project to build the 330-metre complex which should be completed within two years. They put the estimated cost at two billion Saudi riyals ($533 million).
The prince's global interests include stakes in U.S. banking giant Citicorp and Euro Disney as well as international hotels like the luxury Hotel George V in Paris and the Plaza Hotel in New York.
Four Seasons Hotels Inc sold a 25 percent stake in the company and interest in some hotels to the prince in 1995.
